info.name: Workday HCM API
info.description:
Human Capital Management API for managing workforce data, recruiting, talent management, and payroll. Provides RESTful endpoints for core HR operations including workers, organizations, and job data.

Contact Support:
 Name: Workday Support
 Email: support@workday.com
